title: Bounded AC1021+ DIMASSOC DWG field projection and AC1018 boundary
scope: Retain known AcDbOsnapPointRef main/intersection fields already modeled for DXF when reading AC1021+ DIMASSOC bodies. Preserve strict guards where the single-handle/single-path model cannot represent the source. Record the unresolved AC1018 counterexample without changing its reader gate.

sources.title: Autodesk DIMASSOC DXF group table
sources.finding: The documented DXF model includes main subentity/GS marker, near parameter, WCS point, last-point flag, external handle strings, intersection object handle, and intersection subentity/GS marker. See the retained 2026-10-17 DIMASSOC DXF field receipts for the field-by-field map.

sources.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
sources.finding: The local scan did not identify a DIMASSOC object-body field prescription. This receipt does not assert that a synthetic vector is independent evidence for DWG field spans.

sources.title: LibreDWG DWG object grammar
sources.finding: The open-source decoder grammar orders DIMASSOC fields as class TV, osnap type RC, main handle count/vector, optional main subentity/GS marker/XREF path count and strings, near parameter BD and point 3BD, optional intersection handle count/vector/subentity/GS marker/path count and strings, then last-point bit. This agrees with the fields consumed by the updated reader. It is an independent implementation, not normative format authority.

sources.title: LibreDWG 0.14 local reader profile
sources.finding: Independent reader output exposes DIMASSOC records and typed osnap fields for the local AC1021 witness, and decodes 23 DIMASSOC records in the local AC1018 Extruder2 witness. Its successful read establishes reachability and a peer parse only; it does not establish native associative evaluation or this project's output semantics.

implementation.summary: The AC1021+ parser now stores the documented osnap type, main subentity and GS marker, one XREF path, near parameter, WCS point, one intersection handle/subentity/marker/path for intersection types 6 and 11, and last-point flag in the existing DRW_DimensionAssociationOsnapRef model. Unknown classes, excess handle/path cardinalities, missing intersection geometry, and out-of-range DXF subentity values keep the record loss-guarded. Detailed DIMASSOC remains refused by the DWG encoder.
implementation.generatedBytes: The test constructs a small AC1024 frame from scratch in C++; no DWG/DXF sample file was added.

covers: three active association slots with osnap types 1, 6 and 13
main object handles and subentity/GS-marker values
nonzero near parameters and WCS points
main and intersection XREF strings in the detached string stream
intersection object handle and subentity/GS-marker values
no bytes emitted when the DWG encoder refuses the detailed object
